[[File:Imperial_training_academy.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] trained at an Imperial Academy.]]
{{Quote|&hellip;So don't just dream about applying for the Academy, make it come true! You can find a career in space: Exploration, Starfleet, or Merchant Service. If you have the right stuff to take on the universe, dispatch your application and join the ranks of the proud!|Advertisement from an Imperial Space Academy Recruitment tape|<ref name="Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>}}
An '''Imperial Academy''', also known as the '''Imperial Space Academy''' or '''Imperial Service Academy''',<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a military training program managed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and primarily focused on training both the enlisted and officer corps of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==History==
Following the decentralisation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] military after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the Republic had no official military academy. However, the [[Planetary Security Forces]] had maintained the ancient schools on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] and [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] and kept their traditions alive. After the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was this system that the restored [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] drew on to train its officers, rather than the less-esteemed [[Judicial Academy/Legends|Judicial Academy]] of the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]].

By the end of the Clone Wars, the Academy was an elite educational institution that trained youths to become members of the [[Republic Survey Corps/Legends|Exploration]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]], and [[Merchant Galactic/Legends|Merchant Services]].<ref name="Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization">[[Star Wars: The National Public Radio Dramatization|''Star Wars'': The National Public Radio Dramatization]]</ref> Under [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] direction the Empire reformed the Academy and incorporated other institutions used by planetary defense forces and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. It established campuses on many planets throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], producing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] for the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] and officers for both the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] was [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]] of the combined Imperial Academies, and was succeeded by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]] after the former was executed for his failed [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]].<ref name="DVatGP">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], in large part due to the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], thousands of Imperial Academy cadets ended up rapidly advanced into service.<ref name="Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]], many planets associated with the Academy fell under [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] control. The loss of the prestigious Core World of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] and the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Navy War College]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] badly-damaged Imperial hopes of reconquest.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Thereafter the quality of Imperial recruits declined, and the Imperial Navy was forced to make increasing use of recruits trained on the job, and were even forced to order conscription raids to press men into service.<ref name="Heir to the Empire Sourcebook">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The New Republic, meanwhile, took over the Anaxes War College and also established its own [[New Republic Fleet Academy|Fleet Academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

The [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], a major stormtrooper training facility, ceased to exist in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] when [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] was destroyed by the renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] with the [[Sun Crusher]]. Even before then, however, the New Republic was unable to conquer the planet, with General Carlist Rieekan informing Mon Mothma that the best case scenario, albeit difficult, for their plan to weaken the Empire's military infrastructure was containment, and even that was "very long term."<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]], however, remained under the control of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] after the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]].

==Organization==
===Intake===
Prospective [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] for the Navy or Army without the wealth or connections for a highly-placed reference that could fast-track their career began their applications at the [[Star system/Legends|system]] level, attending regional military schools, pilot institutes, or training academies maintained by an individual planetary or system government. Among these was the [[Syndaar Military Prep School]]. These schools varied in quality across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with some schools' qualifications being considered highly impressive, other distinctly less so.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The requirements were very stringent, as very few managed to gain entry level due to the high standards, and even fewer managed to pass the intensive physical and mental challenges in basic training, with desired qualities including bravery, loyalty, intellect, and toughness.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

Cadets who did well in such schools or began with family connections then attended regional sector service academies. A number of these schools were accredited by the Empire, and the facilities for the two arms of the military were known respectively as [[Sector Naval Academy|Sector Naval Academies]] and [[Imperial Army Officer Training Academy|Army Officer Training Academies]]. Here they completed basic training, including tasks such as an [[AT-ST Training Program|AT-ST pilot testing procedure]], learned military history and theory, and took examinations aimed at determining what military career might suit them best.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /><ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

After passing out, cadets were required to dispatch their application to a [[Screening Officer]] of the [[Imperial Recruitment Office]] in their sector.<ref name="Rebel Strike" /> These officers would assign cadets to a specific academy and would recommend the duration and nature of their initial training programme. Once assigned to a service academy, some cadets were graduated, commissioned, and posted to active duty after a minimum term, while others might be transferred repeatedly among academies and assigned different courses of study.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Some of the academies were so classified that only members of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] knew of their existence, while others were renowned names dating back centuries.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

The reasons for Screening Officers' decisions and the convoluted nature of the whole system were subject to many conspiracy theories by cadets, but more often than not these decisions reflected a genuine desire to get the most out of the Empire's considerable investment in a cadet.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> According to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], the academy system was responsible for creating superior officers in the Imperial Military, although [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], himself a former graduate of the academy system, disputed that claim.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> Solo's own Academy progression was atypical: despite his humble background, Solo received a direct referral from [[Renn Tharen]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] shipping magnate, which qualified him for entrance exams without a Sector Naval Academy credential. Clearly a superb pilot, Solo's scores saw him referred directly to [[Flight school/Legends|flight school]] on Carida for two years rather than the three-year posting to officer training on Prefsbelt.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

===Officer training===
Cadets with top scores were invited to take entrance exams for the main service academies, where the Empire trained its most promising [[Officer Candidate]]s. [[Officers' Candidacy Training]] allowed the prospect of becoming part of the Imperial Navy's elite, and allowed for the potential of commanding a strategic military outpost, a TIE squadron, or even a Star Destroyer.<ref name="RPG" /> Each service had its own main academy, supported by a number of schools for specialists, cross-commission training, research and development, and investigations into strategic analysis and theory.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

The [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] was the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] most prestigious Army training institution, located on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It taught a one-year training programme that included both simulations and live-fire drills on drop camps across a variety of [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. After completing training, most graduates of Raithal would be assigned to the [[Corulag Academy]], though the most promising or those seeking specialized Army careers might be assigned to the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

The [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] was the premier center for training for the fleet. Based on [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]], its location was officially classified, and taught [[Midshipman/Legends|Midshipmen]] tactical simulations and leadership before assigning them to active service rotations as [[Ensign/Legends|Ensigns]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Courses included navigation, medicine, engineering, computers, and pilot training in both large and small craft, among others.<ref name="RPG" /> Most cadets entered Naval service after a three-year course at Prefsbelt, but some did shorter courses before shifting to [[Flight school/Legends|flight school]] or continuing their studies at one of the three advanced academies.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

===Specialist training===
The three specialized military schools were the [[Corulag Academy]], the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], and the [[Republic Navy War College/Legends|Anaxes War College]]. [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] was ranked second behind Raithal in prestige by some, and provided additional training to Navy Midshipmen, Army Cadets, flight school [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and specialists from all Imperial services, with an emphasis on active training. The War College, based at [[Anaxes Citadel]], had been considered the embodiment of naval tradition for centuries, and offered active training and combat simulations. It also served as a think tank for promising cadets and active-duty Imperial officers, and tested new warships and equipment for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in training cruises. Finally, the Academy of Carida was a major Stormtrooper training facility, which used the planet's high gravity to build tougher, more resilient troopers. Numerous Army, Navy and flight school cadets also spent semesters there. Carida also housed the [[Officer's Candidate School]] and the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" /> Although Carida was primarily a Stormtrooper academy, those who didn't make the Stormtrooper program were nonetheless allowed admittance into the Army and Navy branches of the Imperial Military as consolation.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

Training for [[TIE pilot]]s occurred separately, and subsequent to the Academy, at a [[Flight school/Legends|flight school]], typically located aboard a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Flight training was reserved for the top graduates of the Sector Naval Academies and Prefsbelt, and was rarely done in a fixed location. The most prestigious was the [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Flight Academy]] housed aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vensenor/Legends|''Vensenor'']]. Flight schools were also located on Carida, and as was the case with Han Solo, honors graduates might be referred to the Prefsbelt Academy for command training, before being posted for further command training in their specialist fields at schools like the highly-regarded [[Austringer Flight School]], which focused on preparing [[Ace/Legends|ace]] pilots to be [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commanders]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

Two other Imperial Military academies attracted cadets, though they were far less prestigious than Raithal and Prefsbelt. The [[Imperial Exploration Academy]] was located in the [[Vanik system/Legends|Vanik system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and trained [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] for the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]]. The [[Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy]] on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] trained personnel for the [[Merchant Galactic/Legends|Merchant Galactic]] and the [[Imperial Supply]] Fleet.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Imperial Sourcebook|''The Imperial Sourcebook'']], the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]] were established as the most prestigious branch of the Imperial Academy for [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] cadets. The appearance of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] in the [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|''Jedi Academy Trilogy'']] does not contradict this: Carida is described as the premier training facility for the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], although Navy and probably Army cadets could also be assigned there.
